ambient_occlusion_live.detail: Reproduced twice. Frames 0-2 run (applied=1, source hook/copy). The fixture Resets the device before frame 3; the trace shows reset_begin/reset_end result=0, taa_invalidate site=reset, motion_output_reset generation=2, then ambient_occlusion_frame frame=3 attached=0 ran=0 reason=attach with no ambient_occlusion_device line, so AO_CREASE frame=3 reports darkened=0 changed=0 and the fixture's 'the crease darkens, most at its centre' check fails.
ambient_occlusion_live.diagnosis: MotionOutput::on_reset (src/proxy/motion_output.cpp:2221) clears ao_attach_failed_ and ao_target_format_ but leaves ao_attach_count_/ao_attach_frame_, so the re-attach hysteresis at motion_output.cpp:1448 (ao_attach_count_ && frame_ < ao_attach_frame_ + ao_reattach_frames, ao_reattach_frames = 60) refuses the post-Reset re-attach for 60 frames. In game this means AO is off for ~1 s after every device Reset (alt-tab, mode change). Not fixed here: this candidate task is build/audit/record only.
